content.short: The Unfrgtn is a multichain holder verification tool that token-gates Discord servers.
content.description: The Unfrgtn checks token and NFT holdings across chains to control access to Discord communities. Its verification service covers more than ten chains, and the same account system drives a Web3 dashboard alongside task-to-earn and play-to-earn activities. The project's own collections, Unfrgtn Orbit and Unfrgtn Aliens, grant access to the tooling.
